newsitem.title: JAPAN: SIMEX Brent unchanged in Singapore holiday.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent unchanged in Singapore holiday.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures prices were barely quoted on Wednesday, as the Singapore International Petroleum Exchange slept-walked through a national holiday.
Other Singapore financial markets were closed.
"It's not very active. In fact it's not really trading at all," a SIMEX official said.
The SIMEX Brent market follows the U.K. trading calender because positions in Singapore can be mutually offset against positions on London's larger International Petroleum Exchange.
As of 0530 GMT, July was bid at $19.90, but there were no offers.
